summary.text: Rui Xu is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 25 since 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A marketing analyst by profession, he is the ranking minority member of the Financial Institutions and Pensions Committee.

paragraphs.text: Rui Xu earned a bachelor's degree in economics from the University of Southern California in 2011.
His career experience includes working as a performance analyst and a marketing analyst, and he is affiliated with the marketing committee for Literacy KC.
Xu assumed office in the Kansas House in 2019.

For 2025 and 2026 he is assigned to the Commerce, Labor and Economic Development, Taxation, and Financial Institutions and Pensions committees, where he is ranking minority member of Financial Institutions and Pensions, as well as the Fiduciary Financial Institutions Oversight and Pensions, Investments and Benefits committees.
